name: Regular City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this regular meeting of the City Council will be held
  in-person. Members of the public may attend to speak during public comment
  or on agenda items, as described below. In order to reduce the risk of
  spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive
  Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20, Public observation and participation will be
  facilitated by the following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s
  website at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo. Members of the public may
  view the meeting and provide public comments in-person in the Albert O. Little
  Community Center subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.

  Public  comments  may  also  be  submitted  by  email at
  publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262,
  extension 200. Comment submitted before 5:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting
  will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  (to be held during COVID-19 emergency)

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 11, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

INVOCATION – RENE TREVINO, CITY OF ARTESIA MAYOR

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – MAYOR PRO TEM RAMOSO CITY OF ARTESIA
COUNCILMEMBER

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS
LISTED UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda and for Public comments received prior to the commencement
of the meeting will be read. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
 Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or other
issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

  1.  2021 FILIPINO AMERICAN HISTORY MONTH PROCLAMATION
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  2.  2021 BREAST CANCER AWARENESS MONTH PROCLAMATION
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  3.  2021 HINDU HERITAGE MONTH PROCLAMATION
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  4.  2021 RED RIBOON WEEK PROCLAMATION
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  STAFF REPORT

BUSINESS PRESENTATION

  6.  ARTESIA LIBRARY UPDATES
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

CONSENT CALENDAR

It is recommended that Items (7) through (14) be acted on simultaneously in one vote
unless a member of the City Council requests separate discussion and/or action on the
item. In the event a member of the City Council requests separate discussion on a
Consent Calendar item, or the item is removed from the Consent Calendar to allow for
public comments on the item to be read. The City Council will consider that item
immediately following approval of the rest of the Consent Calendar.

  7.  WAIVING OF FULL READING OF ORDINANCES LISTED ON AGENDA
  STAFF REPORT

  8.  APPROVAL OF ACCOUNTS PAYABLE CHECK REGISTER
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  9.  APPROVAL OF CITY FINANCIAL REPORTS FOR MAY 2021 AND JUNE 2021
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT
  10. RECEIVE AND FILE INFORMATIONAL ITEM ON TREE STUMP REMOVALS
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

 11. APPROVAL OF FINDINGS TO ALLOW THE CONTINUATION OF
  TELECONFERENCE MEETINGS DUE TO THE CONTINUED PUBLIC HEALTH
  EMERGENCY PURSUANT TO AB 361

  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

 13. APPROVAL TO RESCIND MOTION TAKEN BY THE CITY COUNCIL ON
  FEBRUARY 11, 2019 TO AUTHORIZE THE MAYOR TO SIGN A LETTER
  OPPOSING THE STATE ROUTE 91 WESTBOUND WIDENING PREFERRED

 14. APPROVAL OF A REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF A TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP

  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  17. ADOPTION OF URGENCY ORDINANCE 21-1917U, REVOKING URGENCY

  BUSINESSES IMPACTED BY THE NOVEL CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19)

DISCUSSION

  COMMITTEE MEETINGS ATTENDED

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for additional general comment, announcements, and requests of staff
and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this
time.

  ADJOURNMENT TO THE REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING OF
  NOVEMBER 8, 2021, AT 7:00 P.M.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or
participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff
Reports are on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to
these proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device.

CITY OF ARTESIA

  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 11, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on Monday,
October 11, 2021 at the Albert O. Little Community Center by Mayor Trevino. The Invocation was
presented by Mayor Trevino. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso.

Present:  Rene Trevino, Mayor
  Melissa Ramoso, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember
  Monica Manalo, Councilmember

Also Present:  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Hong Dao Nguyen, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk

MEETING PROCEDURES

  THE CITY CLERK READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS FOLLOWS:

  This regular meeting of the City Council will be held in-person for the City Council
  and Staff. Additionally, members of the public may attend to speak during public
  comment or on agenda items, as described below. In order to reduce the risk of
  spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders
  N-25-20 and N-29-20, Public observation and participation will be facilitated by the
  following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website
  at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo. Members of the public may provide
  public comments in-person in the Albert O. Little Community Center subject to
  posted COVID-19 protocols. Specifically, to reduce the risk of spreading
  coronavirus, one member of the public will be admitted into the Community Center
  at a time in order to provide public comment and/or to speak on agenda item(s).
  When a speaker is finished, they will leave the Community Center in order to
  accommodate the next public speaker. Public comments may also be submitted by
  email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-
  6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 5:00 p.m. on the date of the
  meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.
